name: genkigai-coding-mods
description: Seven Claude Code mods for a coding workflow: context pilot, safety net, change replay, prompt upgrade, session board, workbench and studio

plugins.name: context-pilot
plugins.description: Real context meter, cache tax, growth bumps and automatic handoffs for long work

plugins.name: safety-net
plugins.description: Blast radius before destructive commands, deletes go to a Bin with undo, and Mod Check

plugins.name: change-deck
plugins.description: Step through every edit Claude made, with a file tree and single-edit revert

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: /better turns a rough prompt into a precise one before anything is sent

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: Every running session with timers, and a warning when two sessions edit the same project

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: Idea Shelf, Assumption Check and Reflect into CLAUDE.md

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: Progress band above the prompt, theme skins, pasted-image preview and a web reader
